author: Tony Meyer
content:
We finally got one of these. Interestingly the stamp wasn't franked, so I couldn't tell when it was sent (but it took at least two weeks to arrive), but said it was a $0.98 *US* stamp. If they are sending these all from the US, rather from various countries around the world, like with the iPhoto printing, then it's no wonder it's so slow.
http://ircalc.usps.gov gives $0.98 as the price for "First-Class Mail® International Letter" postage. The next-cheapest option is delivery in 6-10 business days, and is $13.95. So whatever "First-Class" means, it clearly must be more than 6-10 business days.
So this really is just unusable outside of the US, unless you're willing to have your card delivered at some unpredictable date weeks in the future.
